title: Utillian 8 eRig Ruby Pearl Pack
description:
The Utillian 8 comes packed with features & parts, such as ruby terp pearls that allow users to vaporize their wax conveniently. The terp pearls move around your chamber when inhaling from the bubbler. This added feature stirs up your concentrates, reducing the frequency of wax puddles in the BurstHit 3D heating chamber. The additional movement that the pearls provide optimizes the surface area of your chamber for the best flavor extraction. With the addition of these parts, Utillian demonstrates its commitment to creating the smoothest session for users while allowing them to experience quality flavor from even the most basic concentrates.

Includes 5* Utillian 8 Ruby Pearls
